chunks: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
ai.seo_question: Who rejected the warnings in Surah Al-Qamar verse 33?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Qamar, this verse underscores the pattern of 'kudhb' (active denial) by the people of Lot, a theme frequently cited in Shia exegesis to illustrate the consequences of rejecting divine guidance despite clear signs. It connects their specific transgression to the broader Quranic narrative of prophetic missions, emphasizing that their rejection was not merely ignorance but a deliberate dismissal of the 'nudhur' (warners) sent by Allah.
